Definition: from G5375; a Philippesian (Philippian), i.e. native of Philippi:--Philippian.
BiblicalUsage: Philippesios is a Philippian, a native of Philippi, and it appears once, in Paul's thanks to the church there. He says that in the beginning of the gospel, when he departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with him concerning giving and receiving but the Philippians only.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Philippians' giving is the pattern for every church: they gave when no one else did, and Paul never forgot it.
